text: Gomɗii Men Yamirii mo fewndo Men Lonnginnoo mo: " [Men Daali] Werlo mo ka hontoore ɓaawo jibineede makko, liɓaa hontoore nden ka maayo, aray maayo ngon bogoo mo ka fonngo sabu Yamiroore Amen, ƴetta mo gaño Am e gaño makko, on le ko Fir'awna, Mi waɗi e maaɗa Giggol immorde ka Am, yimɓe ɓen yiɗumaa, e fii yo a ne'e e ndenka Am e ngaynateeri Am.
